question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution'.**

Many instances of corruption have been reported by **__authorities posted theyre__.**

options.text: authorities in which were posted theyre

solution:
The correct answer is** "authorities posted there."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the usage of the word "theyre." 
 
• The given sentence has a spelling error and a grammatical issue.
 
• The word** "theyre" **should be corrected to **"there."**
 
• **"There"** means** **in, at or to that place. (वहाँ, उस स्‍थान में या पर)
 
 
• **Example**: *Could you put the table **there**__, please?*
 
 
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: *Many instances of corruption have been reported by authorities posted __**there**__.*
